reasoning: For R, a diagonal pair requires x≡2x modulo 7, equivalently 7 divides x; this holds for some integers but not all, so R is not reflexive. For S, x≡x modulo 9 holds for every integer, so S is reflexive. For T, a diagonal pair would require 6 to divide 2, which is impossible, so T is irreflexive. Thus only S is reflexive, agreeing with Math Academy's captured worked solution.
